author: Mark Atwood
text: Decomposed into 5 independently landable children (Yegge's rule; greenfield session authority too large for one leaf). Land order: .1 (identity/generation/Rule-ID core) -> .2 (bounded tables) -> .3 (authenticated install/currentness/atomic invalidate) -> .4 (24-bit counter + dup/conflict tiles) -> .5 (ACK/abort authz + tombstone hold-down + Link/L2 API). .1-.5 must land in order (each builds on the prior); each is independently testable and landable. Parent released - closes when children do.
